articles.title: Global Market: ECB launches blockchain payment service, to invest in digital securities
articles.content: The European Central Bank launched Pontes, a new service connecting its payment infrastructure with blockchain markets for euro settlements. The ECB also plans to invest a portion of its EUR 23 billion own funds in digital securities, while developing a retail digital euro targeted for a 2029 release.

articles.title: Global Market: Diesel prices surge to record highs as wars squeeze global fuel supplies
articles.content: Global diesel markets are facing mounting supply pressures as refinery outages, export curbs and shipping disruptions reduce availability across Europe, the US and Asia. With inventories below seasonal norms and refineries already running at high utilisation rates, further disruptions could leave fuel markets vulnerable to sharper price increases.

articles.title: Indian bonds steady as RBI rate hike expectations strengthen
articles.content: Bond yields for Indian government securities showed little fluctuation as markets brace for ongoing liquidity withdrawals. Specifically, the yield for the benchmark 2036 bond settled at about 7.05% during early trading on Tuesday. With retail inflation rising to 4.82% in August, expectations mount for a rate hike from the Reserve Bank of India next month.

articles.title: India's first blue bond set for launch next week: Report
articles.content: Sagarmala Finance Corporation plans its maiden blue bond issuance on September 28. The company aims to raise six billion rupees for maritime sector projects. Investors will submit coupon and commitment bids on Monday.
